content.description: Plain markdown content with project-specific instructions, persona definitions, coding style guides, and best practices. No frontmatter allowed. Supports @file.md syntax for importing other files.

examples.content:
# General Instructions

You are a helpful coding assistant.

## Coding Style

- Use TypeScript strict mode
- Follow functional programming patterns
- Write comprehensive tests

# Project Context

This is a Next.js application with TypeScript.

## Architecture

- App Router (not Pages Router)
- Server Components by default
- Client Components only when needed

## Database

PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM
